none: PAS CAM-563E02: Roman Coin : Copper Alloy Barbarous Radiate of Uncertain Emperor
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a radiate Roman coin, barbarous radiate, of DIVVS CLAVDIVS, c.AD275-285 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads [CONSECRATIO]. Reverse shows Altar, type unclear. Mint is unknown. See Cunetio p.160, cf.2873 or 2875. Obverse legend reads [DIVO CLAVDIO]. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Die axis is uncertain. Diameter is 13.64mm, thickness is 1.62mm, weight 0.9g
